versions.changelog:
Initial release: gives agents full email send, receive, and reply capabilities with safety layers.

- Provides a real email address for agents, enabling sending, receiving, and threaded replies.
- All inbound messages undergo prompt injection scanning before being shown to the agent.
- Outbound messages go through a dry-run sandbox with test keys, ensuring nothing is sent accidentally.
- Refuses to send cold or unsolicited emails; supports only transactional, agent-owned messaging.
- Full feature set backed by @mailsai/mcp-server with 20 tools for sending, receiving, identity, and safety operations.
- Free tier available with usage limits and clear setup instructions.
